How it began

Our Story

It all began back in 2014, when Tom and Milly met in sixth form on a residential school trip. After plenty of teasing from their school friends, they decided to give dating a go.

It turned out the timing wasn’t quite right. In 2015, they went their separate ways and lost touch (still Facebook friends though...).

Fast forward five years... They were both single, both living in Surrey with their parents, and completely unaware that their paths were about to cross again.

One reunion at Gostrey Meadows later (mainly so Tom could apologise) and it was as though no time had passed at all.

What started as a teenage interlude had been given a second chance, and this time it felt different.

They could not be happier that they found each other again; the rest is history.

Milly & Thomas

The Barn at Bury Court

Bury Court, Bentley, Farnham, GU10 5LZ · Open in Google Maps →

A converted Oast barn set among wildflower gardens on the Surrey–Hampshire border. Ceremony, drinks, dinner and dancing all take place on site, so once you arrive you won't need to move a muscle.
